name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
summary: Atop the Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII keeps watch over its workings and defenses. The veteran dwarf maintains its great structure and machinery as grave dangers threaten the dam.

sections.title: Master of the Dam
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII tends the Stonewrought Dam, where dwarven stonecraft holds back the waters of the Loch. Along its crest, he watches the waterways and sluice gates, and checks the structure for strain from the elements and local hazards. Its workings demand constant care.

sections.title: Sabotage and Subversion
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII finds signs of planned sabotage at the dam. A breach could flood the lowlands and devastate Khaz Modan's delicate infrastructure. He calls on reliable Alliance adventurers to trace the plot, disarm hidden explosives, and stop the threat before the stone gives way.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarf who maintains and defends the Stonewrought Dam in northern Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can I find Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: You can find Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII on the top walkway of the Stonewrought Dam, which crosses the northern edge of Loch Modan near the Wetlands border.
The Stonewrought Dam is a great dwarven structure that holds back Loch Modan's waters and keeps them from spilling violently into the lower wetlands to the north.

faq.q: What threats is Hinderweir worried about?
aliases: who wants to destroy the dam
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII investigates sabotage at the dam, where he has found signs of dark plots and explosive devices planted to crack its foundations.
VII is the Roman numeral for seven. No record explains why it appears in Hinderweir's name.

faq.q: What quests does Chief Engineer Hinderweir offer?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII offers the chain called 'A Dark Threat Looms', sending adventurers to investigate tampering and protect the Stonewrought Dam from destruction.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Hinderweir's solemn duty: protecting Khaz Modan's greatest works in stone from outside malice.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the dam's vast machinery, joining civil architecture with mechanical control.
As an Alliance member, you cannot afford to let the dam fall. Its destruction would disrupt supply routes and devastate allied lands north of Loch Modan.
